subject: maybe im tempted?
author: PsychedelicBabe
body: 😕Right i am anti paradise personally i just did not feel any love for the game at all.......but when i read this i thought hey hang on a minute I wouldnt mind having a go of this seeing as i spend more time on my pc than i do on my xbox.....a bit contradictal really isnt it?..yeah i thought so too.....i dont know why playing it here on my pc appeals to me more than playing it on my xbox?.....maybe because of the fact that im actually limited to the amount of time i play on my xbox..we have 2 boxes but the kids currently watch the tv that i use to play on.....so yeah on the pc would be cool......😉
